text: 0077 misses its 1 s / 60 s targets under load (cause: spawn on the main thread); build the fix here or ship and follow up?
context: 0077/M measured the braid branch under load (three projects, two gates plus other agents, 15 min; PR #373). Both targets were missed. Reads: after each fresh start every project failed at the 60 s limit (73-157 s) and recovered after about 3 min; the longest read later under two gates was 42 s; dctl-studio failed twice after a start. /api/session after the start: p95 2.6 s, max 6.8 s, 16 % of requests over 1 s (whole run: p95 26.7 s, max 56.6 s). Cause: the board's main thread spent 74 % of the load run inside child_process.spawn (git, t3, gh), about 300 ms per spawn on this machine. The braid's first Completion box (answers within a second under two gates) is not met; the --url and other boxes hold.
